event: 2025 ILCA 4 YOUTH EUROPEAN CHAMPIONSHIPS & OPEN EUROPEAN TROPHY
procedural_matters: The panel of the international jury was composed in accordance with RRS N1.4(b).
ESP 220355 was represented by Sergio Lopez Palacios.
GRE 219471 was represented by Helias Gaviotis.
Jason Kefallonitis (coach of GRE 219471) attended the hearing as interpreter for GRE 219471.
facts: The protest time limit for the ILCA 4 Boys gold Fleet on 25 June was at 15:45.
The Hearing Request was submitted at 15:47.
ESP 220355 made no attempt to submit a paper hearing request availible from the race office.
conclusions: ESP 220355 failed to deliver the protest within the protest time limit, as required by RRS 60.3(b)(1). There was no good reason for the PC to extend the time limit.
decision: The protest is invalid, the hearing is closed under RRS 63.4(a)(1).
